sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Portable Phased-Array Medical Diagnostic Scanners

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law and French Civil Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Vanuatu Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2014 (as amended); International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as amended); Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993 (as amended).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport/identity document of each proposed shareholder, director, secretary, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document's country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement, or lease dated within the last 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, financial institution, or independent attorney in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming professional relationship, account history, and source of funds
Certificate of good standing / legal existence certificate for each corporate shareholder (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or other competent authority in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Independent legal opinion or declaration on the source of wealth and ultimate beneficial ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed attorney or certified public accountant

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory universal screening of all applicants, directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the OFAC SDN list, UN Consolidated Security Council Sanctions list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions list, HM Treasury sanctions list, and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit domestic watchlist. PEP status requires enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and continuous transaction monitoring. Beneficial owners with 25% or more interest must be verified via certified documentation and independent identification.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry e-Services Portal (vfsc.vu/portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin script. English, French, and Bislama (using Latin transliteration) are accepted. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must end with a recognized corporate suffix such as LIMITED, LTD, CORPORATION, CORP, INCORPORATED, INC, SOCIÉTÉ ANONYME, or SA.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant may submit a new name application at no extra fee within 14 days of the rejection notice, or file a written appeal to the Registrar of International Companies citing why the name is not prohibited or misleading. If the Registrar denies the appeal, the applicant may file a further appeal to the Minister of Finance within 30 days. All submissions are made through the licensed registered agent. An extension of name reservation may be requested before expiry for an additional 30-day period, subject to statutory fees.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible. An International Company may use the licensed registered agent's address as its registered office in Vanuatu. A virtual office satisfies the statutory requirement; however, all actual manufacturing and operational activities must be conducted in the substantive business jurisdiction, which must be disclosed to the VFSC for approval and service of process. No local brick-and-mortar premises are required for non-resident international companies.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated <2% annual probability for a non-resident international company with no local operations. Unannounced physical inspections may occur only upon specific AML/CFT suspicion, information request from the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, or a judicial order.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC company name search and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation registration fee (authorized capital up to USD 10,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service (first year)
AML/CFT compliance screening and UBO register preparation (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance service provider / licensed registered agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of due diligence documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Vanuatu consular office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of supporting documents (if required)
Courier, certificate issuance, and administrative expediting fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Act No. 4 of 1992), ss. 1-16 (incorporation), s. 29 (share capital), s. 55 (registered office), s. 63 (registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry and International Companies Section, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association (Charter), registered agent consent, and registered office consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital required; authorized capital may be denominated in any freely convertible currency, shares may be allotted below authorized capital, and no escrow or deposit arrangement is mandated
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — RESOLVED that the subscribers subscribe to and allot the initial share capital as recorded in the register of members; RESOLVED FURTHER that the premises at the registered agent's office, Port Vila, Vanuatu, be adopted as the registered office, the registered agent being authorised to maintain statutory records and file notifications with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed Sole Director, [Name] Company Secretary, and [Name] Compliance Officer, each serving until the next annual general meeting or removal by resolution; RESOLVED FURTHER that officers be authorised to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and discharge filing obligations. CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and VFSC Eligibility Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, Port Vila (submission via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request listing three ranked candidate names. Confirm that the chosen name does not contain restricted words (e.g., bank, trust, insurance, assurance) absent a separate VFSC license, and does not conflict with an existing registered name. Obtain VFSC written approval of the reserved name before filing the Charter.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or reserved by another applicant, file an immediate alternative name list; request a written statement of refusal grounds and appeal to the VFSC Registrar within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Charter and Constitutional Dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association (Charter) containing the objects clause covering the manufacture, assembly, distribution, and export of medical diagnostic imaging devices (ISIC 3250). Have the subscriber(s) execute the Charter before a notary or independent witness and append the registered agent's consent and registered office consent.
required_dossiers: Subscriber identity and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar returns the documents for correction, amend the defective clauses and re-file within 14 days of the notice; no additional filing fee is levied for corrected re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Authorized Share Capital Declaration and Subscriber Allotment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Declare the authorized share capital in the Charter (e.g., USD 10,000 divided into 10,000 ordinary shares). Issue subscriber share certificates for the allotted shares and prepare the return of allotment. No paid-up capital deposit or escrow verification is required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the capital structure, file an amended capital statement re-denominating the share classes; the amendment is processed as a charter alteration without requiring an escrow account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Incorporation Filing and Statutory Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 together with the executed Charter, consents, and registered agent certificate. Pay the statutory filing fee of approximately USD 350 (or VUV equivalent) via bank wire or VFSC-approved electronic payment. Request standard processing (5 days) or expedited one-day incorporation.
required_dossiers: Ultimate beneficial owner due diligence declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer any VFSC query by supplementary declaration; if the application is rejected, correct the stated defects and re-submit; file a formal objection with the VFSC Registrar within 21 days of the rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and file-stamped Charter. The registered agent then assembles the corporate kit containing the common seal, share certificates, and statutory registers (members, directors, charges). Convene the first board meeting to adopt the first board resolution appointing officers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error, apply for re-issuance in the corrected legal name; replace any deficient statutory registers before undertaking commercial transactions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registration, Good Standing, and Banking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), and authorized banking institutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the annual VFSC license fee to maintain good standing. If any local physical presence or workforce is established, register the project with VIPA under the Foreign Investment Act and obtain a Foreign Investment Certificate; obtain a municipal business license and tax identification number for any local payroll, while preserving the zero-tax status of the company's offshore income. Open a corporate bank account for SWIFT LC and TT Wire settlement rails.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening pack (passport, board resolution, beneficial ownership declaration, business plan)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A VIPA denial may be cured by adjusting the foreign investment scope and re-filing; appeal to the Minister of Trade within 30 days. For bank account refusal, re-submit with enhanced beneficial ownership evidence and a compliance officer attestation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), coordinated with the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce, and the Port Vila or Luganville Municipal Council business licensing division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Certificate (Medical Device Assembly and Export) together with Municipal Business License for Manufacturing and Wholesale Distribution

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - EIA Registration (limited environmental footprint); a full EIA Report scoping is required only if the facility introduces electroplating, photolithographic etching, or solvent-intensive processes beyond final phased-array ultrasound console assembly
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must meet the effluent standards under the Water Resources Management Act; VOC and solvent emissions controlled per the Environmental Protection Regulations; e-waste, fluorescent lamp, and chemical waste export must comply with Basel Convention transboundary movement permits; packaging waste must be segregated and recycled under municipal waste directives; medical device component cleanliness effluents must be neutralized before discharge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service and Municipal Building Control; structural load inspection certificate for the assembly facility; workplace safety registration under the Health and Safety at Work Act with the Department of Labour; electrical installation clearance from the Vanuatu Utilities Regulation authority; occupational clearance for calibration laboratory and IT server room load certification.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; online taxpayer portal: https://www.customs.gov.vu and Tax Administration System (TAS)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company obtains its statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) by filing the VRCD taxpayer registration application (Form VAT 001) together with the Certificate of Incorporation issued under the International Companies Act 1992, the registered agent's certificate, and certified identity documents of each beneficial owner; the application is submitted electronically through the VRCD Tax Administration System and the TIN is issued within 5-10 business days; no minimum capital or physical presence is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: International Companies (ICs) may elect under the International Companies Act 1992 to operate as a 'Compliant IC' for transparency and AML purposes, may elect to convert to a local exempt company, and may voluntarily revoke their tax-exempt status; no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections are available because Vanuatu imposes no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on ICs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 annual taxable turnover; voluntary registration is permitted below this threshold but no IC may supply goods or services inside Vanuatu, so domestic VAT registration is generally unavailable or irrelevant for an IC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based e-invoicing mandate exists in Vanuatu; VAT-registered businesses must issue serially numbered VAT invoices and submit periodic VAT returns through the VRCD online tax administration system; exports are evidenced by standard customs declarations rather than government-cleared e-invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods, including portable phased-array medical diagnostic scanners and color Doppler ultrasound consoles, are zero-rated under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 where the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within the statutory period and the recipient is located outside Vanuatu; international services and services physically performed outside Vanuatu are also zero-rated; an International Company is wholly exempt from Vanuatu VAT and is not obligated to charge VAT on offshore export turnover.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs Form V78)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating or export claims trigger retrospective VAT assessments, full clawback of zero-rated input tax credits, interest at 20% per annum, monetary penalties up to 200% of tax evaded, and criminal prosecution of directors and beneficial owners under the VAT Act 1998 and Customs Act 1986; failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days is treated as an unsubstantiated export and may result in imposition of VAT liability plus civil penalties, cancellation of the exporter's registration, and personal liability of company officers.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) in conjunction with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) is the overall monetary and exchange-monitoring authority. The RBV supervises banking and payment systems while the VFSC administers international corporate licensing and AML/CFT compliance for International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalized exchange-control regime. The Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for both current account and capital account transactions. There are no restrictions, quotas, or approval gates on profit remittance, dividend distribution, or capital repatriation for International Companies. Funds can be freely held and transferred in VUV or any foreign currency, subject only to general AML/CFT reporting thresholds and balance-of-payments statistical disclosure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no export-proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no statutory repatriation deadline. Export receipts for medical equipment sales may be retained in USD, EUR, or any freely usable currency in a licensed VFSC-approved bank outside or inside the jurisdiction. A transaction-level record is required for RVB statistical returns but no form of exchange control enforcement is applied.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Vanuatu allows licensing of fintech and electronic money institutions under the Financial Dealers Act and the National Payments System Regulation. Offshore digital EMIs can technically open remote accounts for VU International Companies, but they are not suitable for holding statutory trust funds or capital escrow deposits required under VFSC licensing rules. A licensed offshore EMI may only serve as a supplemental clearing channel for operational disbursements, and the main bank account must remain with a domestic commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permitted. Vanuatu does not mandate physical director presence for a standard non-personal banking account. Directors may be onboarded through a live video interview, digital identity verification, certified copies of passports, and a notarized board resolution. The incumbent bank may request a business-verification call or a physical visit only under enhanced due diligence, but not as a statutory requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company showing little or no substantive economic activity in Vanuatu and no clear operational nexus in Asia-Pacific.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the current International Company registration certificate, certificate of good standing, audited financial statements, evidence of offshore operating presence (e.g., Hong Kong or Singapore office lease, employer records, utility bills), and a detailed corporate chart on Form 3B demonstrating economic substance and source-of-wealth narrative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex ownership structure using nominee shareholders or discretionary trusts, triggering UBO identification difficulty and potential FATCA/CRS red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a complete beneficial ownership map, full legal trust deed and nominee shareholder deed, source-of-wealth letters from each UBO, and a waiver allowing the bank to obtain tax-residency self-certifications under IRS W-8BEN-E and CRS documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity inward trade payments from medical equipment distributors located in jurisdictions with a higher financial-action-task-force risk profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide signed sales contracts, proforma invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, cargo insurance certificates, and import permits of the buyer's jurisdiction. A letter from the corresponding beneficiary bank confirming the buyer's good standing, plus copies of underlying regulatory approvals for the color Doppler ultrasound device, will be required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Product is a regulated medical diagnostic scanner, creating regulatory exposure if the company cannot demonstrate legal medical-device export rights.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply valid ISO 13485 certificate, CE-marking approval or FDA registration, national health authority export certificate, exclusive distributor agreements, and all product certificates establishing that ISIC 3250 manufacturing and distribution rights are lawfully held by the VU_IC entity or its affiliate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital injection must be routed as a SWIFT MT103 payment using balance-of-payments purpose code 'Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) equity injection' or 'Debt elimination/settlement'. The beneficiary name must match the VU International Company's legal name and bank account without abbreviation. A certificate of inward remittance must be obtained from the receiving bank and maintained with the company records. The remitter must include the corporate registration number and the statement 'OBLIGOR-FREE CAPITAL FUNDS' to avoid misclassification under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to overseas component manufacturers are executed via SWIFT MT103 for wire transfers and MT700/MT707 for documentary letters of credit. For medical device parts, a documentary LC with shipping inspection certificate, warehouse receipt, and ISO 13485 quality certification is the preferred rail to preserve title security. All outward remittances equal to or exceeding VUV 100 million (approximately USD 850,000) require a completed Outward Remittance Form for monetary statistics reporting to the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot VUV/USD, VUV/EUR, VUV/AUD transactions through any licensed domestic bank
Deliverable forward VUV/USD contracts with tenors up to 12 months
Non-deliverable forward VUV/USD (NDF) executed offshore with a credible prime broker
Cross-currency swap between VUV and USD for balance-sheet hedging
Interest rate swap in VUV or USD where the underlying exposure arises from trade finance facilities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 20,000 (approx. USD 165) for returns submitted after the 30-day window; sustained failure to file may trigger administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (embedded in Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary deadline as the Annual Return; filed simultaneously by the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate fee; false, incomplete, or omitted beneficial ownership particulars attract statutory fines and officer liability; persistent non-compliance supports administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. International Companies are statutorily exempt from mandatory independent audit; an audit is required only if voluntarily imposed by the company's constitutional documents or approved by shareholder resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory local GAAP. Books and records are commonly maintained on an IFRS-basis or other recognized accounting basis sufficient to show and explain transactions; audited financial statements are not lodged with the VFSC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Company must maintain a register of beneficial owners and update it within 14 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership; the Annual Return must include confirmation that the register is complete, accurate, and up to date.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350–800 per annum (resident agent and registered office services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; voluntary independent audit typically USD 1,500–3,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (nil). Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, and no undistributed profits tax. The Income Tax Act was repealed in 1987 and no direct taxation statute is currently in force.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory tax exemption for International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. An IC engaged in ISIC 3250 (manufacture and export of portable phased-array color Doppler ultrasound consoles) pays no Vanuatu income tax on manufacturing-export margins, is outside the scope of the Value Added Tax Act 1998 where it makes only export supplies, and is exempt from stamp duty on the issue and transfer of its shares. The IC's only sovereign levy is the annual VFSC retention fee attached to its annual return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The mandatory statutory filing for an International Company is the VFSC Annual Return (lodgment prescribed under Section 128 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]), filed electronically through the VFSC e-Services portal (https://services.vfsc.vu) or by the licensed registered agent via its permitted electronic lodgment channel.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, fixed to the anniversary date of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and the accompanying government annual fee must be filed and paid no later than thirty (30) calendar days after each anniversary date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company, its VFSC company registration number, and the date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name and number shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; any foreign registered trade name must be separately notified to the Registrar before lodgment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu and the name and license number of the VFSC-licensed registered agent acting for the company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A post-office box alone is insufficient; the registered agent must hold a current International Corporate Services Provider license issued by the VFSC and must countersign the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport or national ID numbers of all directors, the secretary, and any officer of the company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may be appointed without any Vanuatu residency or work-permit requirement; however, the named individuals must be natural persons and each must consent in writing to the appointment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 – Shareholders and Ultimate Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes of shares issued, number of shares, holder names, allotment dates, and the statutory declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership under the AML/CFT framework.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List every ultimate beneficial owner regardless of domicile. Nominee shareholders must file a declaration identifying the underlying principal; failure to disclose is an AML offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: A precise narrative description of the company's commercial activities during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must confirm that it has not transacted with any Vanuatu resident and has not derived income from Vanuatu sources. Appropriate wording: 'manufacture and offshore export distribution of portable phased-array color Doppler ultrasound consoles to Asia-Pacific medical buyers'. Avoid any wording suggesting a local place of business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the company carried on a relevant activity under the Economic Substance Regulations and whether it claims tax residence in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the IC claims foreign tax residence, attach the foreign tax residence certificate (TRC) and board minutes approving the foreign residence position. Where no valid TRC exists, the IC must demonstrate economic substance in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act, signed by at least one director and countersigned by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A director may sign electronically via the VFSC portal; the registered agent must countersign as the statutory filer. A materially false declaration attracts criminal liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Government annual retention fee of VUV 50,000 (approximately USD 430) plus the registered agent's professional fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit by TT wire from outside Vanuatu to the VFSC designated account using the company name and registration number as payment reference; SWIFT LC is not an accepted rail for government fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file within 30 days of the anniversary triggers a late-payment surcharge of 25% of the annual fee. Default beyond 60 days allows the VFSC to issue a formal default notice. Continued non-payment beyond 90 days authorizes the Registrar to strike the company off the International Companies Register without further notice. A struck-off IC may not lawfully contract; reinstatement is discretionary, conditioned on payment of all arrears, penalties, a reinstatement fee of approximately VUV 100,000, and a sworn statutory declaration of solvency.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (nil). Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, whether on cash dividends, deemed dividends, or distributions in kind, and no stamp duty or remittance tax attaches to shareholder distributions made by an International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network, so no treaty relief claim is required to reduce any Vanuatu dividend withholding (there being none). Where the foreign shareholder's home jurisdiction imposes inbound tax on the dividend, the IC or shareholder should obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency and Non-Resident Status issued by the Vanuatu Department of Finance and Treasury. The administrative protocol is: (i) file a written application with the Director General of Finance; (ii) attach certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, the latest VFSC annual return, and a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; (iii) attach a board resolution resolving the dividend and identifying the payee; and (iv) pay the prescribed certification fee (approximately VUV 10,000). The certificate is then lodged with the foreign revenue authority in support of a foreign tax credit or participation-exemption claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on royalty payments for licensed IP (including embedded software and firmware in the color Doppler ultrasound console) and 0% on interest paid by the IC to non-resident lenders. Because no DTA network is in force, the zero statutory rate operates as the effective source rate in all contexts; however, the payer's jurisdiction abroad may still impose its own domestic withholding, and the IC may invoke the payor country's applicable double tax convention where one exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 (nil statutory threshold). Vanuatu has no domestic transfer pricing, thin capitalization, controlled foreign company, or transfer-pricing documentation legislation, so no Local File or Master File is legally triggered. Notwithstanding the absence of a codified threshold, cross-border transactions (Swift_LC and TT_Wire sales of medical devices to foreign distributors) should be supported by an arm's-length benchmark analysis so that the trading counterparty's revenue authority does not recharacterize the IC's pricing on audit.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2019 and the Economic Substance Regulations 2019 require every International Company that carries on a 'relevant activity' to satisfy economic substance tests in Vanuatu unless it proves tax residence in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction by lodging a valid foreign TRC with the VFSC. For this scope (ISIC 3250 – manufacture and export distribution of color Doppler ultrasound consoles), the activity is analyzed as 'Distribution and Service Centre Business'. The IC must (a) file the prescribed Economic Substance Report with the annual return; (b) hold board meetings and make strategic decisions in Vanuatu; (c) maintain a permanent physical office with adequate full-time employees proportionate to the medical-equipment workload; (d) incur adequate operating expenditure locally; and (e) perform the core income-generating activities in Vanuatu, including contract negotiation, inventory and logistics risk oversight, and supervision of the SWIFT LC and TT wire export channels. Reliance solely on a registered agent or virtual-office packaging is fatal to the substance defense.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Local Business / Unlicensed Vanuatu Trade
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC supplies, installs, or services color Doppler ultrasound consoles for any Vanuatu resident (including a Port Vila hospital, clinic, or domestic distributor) without first obtaining a separate Vanuatu business license and the written consent of the Minister responsible for international companies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The prohibited transaction is void ab initio. The IC and every participating officer are exposed to an offence fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 (approximately USD 8,500) per contravention under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], and the VFSC may cancel the IC's registration and refuse re-registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent who knowingly procured the local trade are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution to the counterparty, subject to Supreme Court proceedings; the Registrar may issue a disqualification order barring each director from acting as an officer of any company registered in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the cross-border distribution business with no physical presence in Vanuatu, holding all board meetings abroad, filing an Economic Substance Report that falsely claims foreign tax residence without a valid TRC, and performing no core income-generating activity in any real jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: False or omitted ESR filings attract VFSC financial penalties of up to VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 43,000), compulsory deregistration of the IC, and regulatory action against the licensed registered agent involved in the filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors remain personally exposed to foreign tax-attack reattribution of the trading profits (CFC and offshore anti-abuse rules in the shareholder's home state), the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may impose international travel-restriction notices, and the VFSC may disqualify the directors from office in any Vanuatu company for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Swift_LC or TT_Wire proceeds from Asia-Pacific medical distribution chains without performing customer due diligence, screening sanctions-affected jurisdictions or persons, or maintaining the statutory beneficial-ownership and transaction records; alternatively, structuring invoices through straw-man consignees to obscure the true purchaser or the origin of funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014, deficient AML programs attract civil penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 (approximately USD 86,000), the Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze all affected wire proceeds, and attributed money laundering is punishable by imprisonment of up to 15 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The FIU may apply to the Supreme Court for pecuniary penalty orders and asset-freezing orders over the directors' personal property; the directors face imprisonment terms of up to 15 years, and the FIU may issue an international travel-restriction notice preventing departure from Vanuatu pending the investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Material False Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly delivering false statements to the VFSC or to the Department of Finance — for example, under-declaring the ultimate beneficial owner, fabricating a foreign tax-residence certificate, or structuring the IC's export invoices to assist foreign buyers in evading customs duties, import VAT, or corporate tax in destination jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The false-declaration offence under the VFSC Act 1999 and the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] carries a fine of up to VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 43,000) and/or imprisonment of up to 7 years; the Registrar may deregister the IC and declare contracts executed during the period of deception void.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the signatory officer are treated as primary offenders rather than mere agents of the company; criminal conviction triggers automatic civil restitution of all concealed profits, disqualification from corporate office, and, given the foreign-controlled character of an IC, provisional seizure of the directors' personal assets by order of the Supreme Court.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Continuing to accept purchase orders and execute supply contracts for ultrasound consoles after the VFSC strike-off for non-payment of annual fees or after the ESR report has been administratively deemed void, thereby misrepresenting a defunct corporate shell as an operating exporter to foreign medical distributors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Contracts made by a struck-off company are void; every person acting in the name of the struck-off company commits an offence under the International Companies Act punishable by fine up to VUV 1,000,000 (approximately USD 8,500) and imprisonment, and the VFSC will reject any reinstatement application until all government fees, penalties, and a corrective statutory declaration are submitted.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: directors are personally liable for the aggregate unpaid invoices, supply-contract damages, and the costs of any foreign winding-up petition; civil restitution orders may be registered against the directors' personal real property in Vanuatu; and persistent offenders face travel bans and a statutory bar on re-entry to any licensed corporate role in the Republic.
